{{nihongo|'''Kaehime Shrine'''|鹿江比賣神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

[[ファイル:葦稲葉神社（鹿江比売神社）の石碑.jpg|サムネイル|Commemorative monument at Ashiinaba Shrine (Kaehime Shrine).]]
'''Kaehime Shrine''' (also written '''Kaehime Shrine''') (かえひめじんじゃ) is a {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=shrine (Shikinaisha)}} listed in the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}''.

=== Overview ===
In the ''Engishiki Jinmyōchō'', under {{ill|Awa Province (Tokushima)|be|Ава (правінцыя, Сікоку)|cs|Provincie Awa (Tokušima)|de|Provinz Awa (Tokushima)|es|Provincia de Awa (Tokushima)|fa|ولایت آوا|fr|Province d'Awa (Tokushima)|gl|Provincia de Awa, Tokushima|id|Provinsi Awa (Tokushima)|it|Awa (provincia, Tokushima)|ja|阿波国|ko|아와국 (난카이도)|lt|Avos žemė (Tokušima)|nl|Awa (Tokushima)|pt|Província de Awa (Tokushima)|ru|Ава (Сикоку)|simple|Awa Province (Tokushima)|sk|Awa (provincia, Tokušima)|sr|Провинција Ава (Шикоку)|tr|Awa (vilayet, Tokushima)|uk|Провінція Ава (Шікоку)|zh|阿波國|zh_min_nan|Awa-kok (Nankaidô)|qid=Q907457}} {{ill|Itano District, Tokushima|ceb|Itano-gun|es|Distrito de Itano|fr|District d'Itano|id|Distrik Itano, Tokushima|it|Distretto di Itano|ja|板野郡|ko|이타노군|pl|Powiat Itano|uk|Повіт Ітано|zh|板野郡|qid=Q1156025}}, it is listed as a small shrine (kokuhei shōsha). There is a record that on September 5, 883 (Genkei 7), it was promoted to Junior Fifth Rank Upper (''{{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|cs|Nihon Sandai Džicuroku|de|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|es|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|fa|نیهون ساندای جیتسوروکو|ff|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|fr|Nihon sandai jitsuroku|it|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|ja|日本三代実録|ko|일본삼대실록|pt|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|ru|Нихон сандай дзицуроку|simple|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|zh|日本三代實錄|zh_classical|日本三代實錄|qid=Q1052981}}''). At present, the following two shrines are considered candidate {{ill|Shikinai Ronsha|Q135022904|qid=Q135022904}}. The enshrined deity is thought to be Kaehime no Kami (no Mikoto), and from the reading "kaehime" it is considered the same deity as {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kayanohime}} (appearing as "Kayanohime" in the ''{{ill|Kojiki|ace|Kojiki|ar|كوجيكي|az|Kociki|bcl|Kojiki|be|Кодзікі|bg|Коджики|ca|Kojiki|ckb|کۆجیکی|cs|Kodžiki|da|Kojiki|de|Kojiki|eo|Koĝiki|es|Kojiki|et|Kojiki|eu|Kojiki|fa|کوجیکی|fi|Kojiki|fr|Kojiki|gl|Kojiki|he|קוג'יקי|hi|कोजिकी|hr|Kojiki|hu|Kodzsiki|hy|Կոձիկի|id|Kojiki|it|Kojiki|ja|古事記|ka|კოძიკი|kk|Кодзики|kn|ಕೋಜಿಕಿ|ko|고사기|la|Kojiki|lt|Kodžiki|mk|Коџики|ml|കൊജികി|ms|Kojiki|my|ခိုဂျိခိ|nl|Kojiki|no|Kojiki|oc|Kojiki|pl|Kojiki|pt|Kojiki|ro|Kojiki|rsk|Кодїки|ru|Кодзики|sh|Kojiki|simple|Kojiki|sk|Kodžiki|sl|Kodžiki|sr|Коџики|sv|Kojiki|ta|கோஜிகி|th|โคจิกิ|tl|Kojiki|tr|Kojiki|uk|Кодзікі|vi|Cổ sự ký|zh|古事記|zh_classical|古事記|qid=Q813031}}'' and as "Kusa no Oya Kayanohime" in the ''{{ill|Nihon Shoki|Q813935|qid=Q813935}}''). She is treated as a deity of {{ill|grass|ja|草|zh|草 (消歧义)|zh_yue|草 (搞清楚)|qid=Q11618055}}, but in fact is Chikakahi-me no Mikoto, child of {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ōasahiko no Mikoto}} and younger sister of {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Yufutsu-nushi no Mikoto}}, a deity of the Awa Imbe lineage{{要出典|date=2022年3月}}.

* Kaehime no Mikoto enshrined at {{ill|Ashiinaba Shrine|ja|葦稲葉神社|qid=Q11621139}}, which is {{ill|Co-Enshrinement|Q11412524|qid=Q11412524}} in {{ill|Kamiita, Tokushima|Q1350072|qid=Q1350072|lt=Kamiita Town, Itano District, Tokushima Prefecture}}
* Kaehime Shrine, a small shrine within {{ill|Ōasahiko Shrine|fr|Ōasahiko-jinja|ja|大麻比古神社|zh|大麻比古神社|qid=Q723417}} located in {{ill|Naruto, Tokushima|Q460812|qid=Q460812|lt=Naruto City, Tokushima Prefecture}}
